mapping: For v=1..100: minimum * (maximum/minimum)^((v-1)/99). Zero bypasses that filter.
design: Cascaded stereo second-order TPT state-variable high-pass and low-pass, Butterworth Q=1/sqrt(2), 12 dB/oct each.
smoothing: Per-filter 256-sample wet ramp and per-block coefficient smoothing. Exact dry pass-through after bypass settles.
persistence: Existing 128-byte stock effect snapshot and record CRC, no new record format. FX A/B extension retained.
latency: No extra block buffering. Frequency-dependent phase/group delay is inherent in the filters; no measured end-to-end latency claim.
